findings.title: Cache is not rechecked after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Two concurrent non-Dev callers can both observe a nil cache at line 41, then serialize on the write lock. The second caller does not recheck entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring the lock at line 48, so it reloads assets-manifest.json despite the first caller having populated the cache. More importantly, if that redundant reload fails, line 69 assigns its nil result over the valid cache and the caller returns an error instead of the already-available assets. Add a non-Dev cache recheck inside the write lock before reloading.

findings.title: No concurrent regression test for the claimed data-race fix
findings.body: The change introduces mutex protection for entryPointAssetsCache but adds no test that calls GetWebAssets concurrently, ideally repeatedly under `go test -race` with both cache-miss and cache-hit paths. Without such a test, a future change that accesses the global outside entryPointAssetsCacheMu or mutates the shared returned value would not be caught by CI as a race regression.
